column1: # scripts/gate/steps.tsv — the ONE step registry. Local runs, `make`, the pre-push hook and every CI
# job read this file through scripts/gate/run.sh. Adding a check = adding a row here.
# Columns (TAB-separated; no tabs inside a field):
#   id        unique step id (also the results/<id>.json file name)
#   job       the CI job that runs it: static | swift | cpp | asan | tsan
#   tiers     comma list of local tiers: push (T1) | check (T2) | combine (T3) | ci (T4) | gate
#             ("gate" is the `make gate` chain; "ci" includes every row)
#   blocking  yes = a failure turns the verdict red; advisory = reported, never red
#   timeout   per-step watchdog, e.g. 90s, 5m, 1h. A hang is killed and named "timed out".
#   coverage  files | tests | - . A step with files or tests MUST print `GATE_COVERED <n>` with n >= 1,
#             or it FAILS: a step that checked nothing is not a pass (a misspelt filter runs 0 tests).
#   needs     a step id that must PASS first, or - . Every run also needs toolchain-parity first.
#   command   run from the repo root, through bash -c, in its own process group.
# Every step today's scripts/strict-gate.sh runs is here (mapping: scripts/gate/README.md).
